title: Electropermeabilization-based fluorescence in situ hybridization of whole-mount plant parasitic nematode specimens
author: Ruark-Seward, Davis, et al.

steps.title: Prewarm buffers
steps.instruction: Prewarm the hybridization buffer at 46 °C and the hybridization wash buffer at 50 °C.

steps.title: Pellet nematodes
steps.instruction: Collect hatched second‑stage juvenile (ppJ2) nematodes in a 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube and centrifuge for 2 min at 4000 × g (low speed).

steps.title: Remove excess liquid
steps.instruction: Using a pipette, remove liquid leaving approximately 10 µl of fluid surrounding the nematode pellet.

steps.title: Surface sterilize nematodes
steps.instruction: Add 200 µl of 0.1 % (w/v) benzalkonium chloride solution to the pellet, incubate 1 min at room temperature, then centrifuge 1 min at 6000 × g.

steps.title: Discard supernatant
steps.instruction: After centrifugation, carefully aspirate and discard ~200 µl of supernatant.

steps.title: Rinse and re‑pellet
steps.instruction: Rinse the nematodes with 200 µl sterile water, centrifuge 2 min at 4000 × g, and remove excess liquid.

steps.title: Resuspend for probes
steps.instruction: Resuspend each sample in 50 µl sterile water for each probe reaction (e.g., 200 µl total water for four different probe reactions).

steps.title: Add probes in cuvette
steps.instruction: Transfer 50 µl of the nematode suspension into a 0.4 cm‑gap electroporation cuvette, then add probe to a final concentration of 150 µM (1.5 µl of 100 µM probe in TE buffer: 10 mM Tris‑HCl, 1 mM EDTA, pH 7.4).

steps.title: Electroporate samples
steps.instruction: Electroporate the nematode/probe mixture with a single‑pulse square wave at 125 V for 20 ms.

steps.title: Add hybridization buffer
steps.instruction: Add 100 µl of pre‑warmed (46 °C) hybridization buffer (20 mM Tris‑HCl pH 7.4, 0.02 % w/v SDS, 0.9 M NaCl, 5 mM EDTA, 60 % v/v formamide) to the electroporated suspension.

steps.title: Hybridization incubation
steps.instruction: Transfer the mixture to a 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube and incubate for 4 h at 46 °C in the dark on a gently rocking platform (or a stationary heat block placed on a rocker).
